biotools.summary: ADTnorm is a normalization and integration method designed for CITE-seq datasets, addressing batch effects in ADT expression. It improves cell-type identification and enables atlas-level analyses by accurately aligning populations and providing utilities for threshold-gating and antibody panel selection.
